rationale: The unchanged original full-unit oracle already requires jq; v1 failed before candidate application. Adding the missing required OS utility corrects execution prerequisites rather than changing a fault, assertion, selector or test scope.
v1_verdict: Retain original ineligible baseline and all immutable evidence. Do not describe v1 as passing or count it among v2 repetitions.
mandatory_conditions: Record a platform-only jq absence/presence diagnosis; do not rerun the project script or tests for diagnosis.
Use a separate v2 study path, freeze, image and result namespace; retain v1 image/freeze/results byte-identically.
Provision only jq and its necessary OS libraries, recording exact package versions and before/after OS-package inventory. Retain failures; do not silently upgrade unrelated components.
Project source, all471original unit files, original configuration, npm lock and installed Node dependency files must remain byte-identical to v1 baseline.
The frozen candidate must remain the identical one-line public historical-hunk inverse. No new fault or selector optimization.
Use the identical original full-unit/native-selection commands, environment assumptions, reporting rules and resource boundaries; only platform utility provisioning and versioned metadata may differ.
Require a new complete passing original baseline in each of three fresh v2 repetitions. Do not shrink the unit universe, skip the failing suite, or reuse v1 baseline/cache.
No positive result is assumed. Preserve every unsuccessful or ineligible v2 result and independently audit raw outcomes before any manuscript claim.
scope: Platform correction only; no source/test/gate changes and no current candidate result.

native_selector_primary_source.observation: The changedSince branch unions committed-diff paths, staged-diff paths and git ls-files --other --modified --exclude-standard paths.
native_selector_primary_source.implication: The fixed uncommitted production candidate is considered by native changedSince selection. No candidate commit, Git-reference change or selector change is required.
native_selector_primary_source.scope: Static source inspection only; no candidate selection was executed.
